service: Agent Registry lets callers discover, list, and retrieve approved records published to a registry.

operations.BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecord: Retrieves multiple discoverable registry records by ID from a single registry. Records that cannot be retrieved are reported individually in the errors list rather than failing the entire request.
operations.ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords: Lists the discoverable registry records in a registry. You can optionally filter and paginate the results.
operations.SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecords: Searches the discoverable registry records in a registry using a natural language query. Returns metadata for the matching records ordered by relevance.

A2aAgentCardDescriptor.base: Base mixin for A2A agent card descriptor content

AccessDeniedException.base: The caller is not authorized to perform the requested action.

AgentSkillsAdditionalData.base: Additional data for an agent skills definition descriptor.

refs.AgentSkillsDefinitionDescriptor$addition: Additional data for the agent skills definition, such as the skills markdown descriptor.

AgentSkillsDefinitionDescriptor.base: Base mixin for agent skills definition descriptor content

AgentSkillsMdDescriptor.base: Base mixin for agent skills markdown descriptor content

BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecordError.base: Describes why a requested record could not be retrieved.

refs.BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecordError$: The machine-readable reason that the record could not be retrieved.

refs.BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecordRespon: The per-record errors for records that could not be retrieved. This list is empty when all requested records were returned.

refs.BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecordReques: The registry-scoped groups of record IDs to retrieve. Currently, you can specify exactly one entry.

DescriptorSource.base: The source location from which a descriptor's content was retrieved.

refs.A2aAgentCardDescriptor$source: The source location from which the A2A (Agent-to-Agent) agent card descriptor content was retrieved.
refs.AgentSkillsMdDescriptor$source: The source location from which the agent skills markdown content was retrieved.
refs.McpServerDescriptor$source: The source location from which the MCP (Model Context Protocol) server descriptor content was retrieved.

DescriptorSourceFromUrl.base: Base mixin for descriptor source from URL

Descriptors.base: The protocol-specific descriptors that describe how to connect to and use the registry record.

refs.RegistryRecordSummary$descriptors: The protocol-specific descriptors that describe how to connect to and use the record.

refs.RegistryRecordFilter$values: The values to match for the attribute.

DiscoverableRegistryRecordSummary.base: Summary information about a discoverable registry record returned by ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords. This summary does not include descriptors.

refs.ListDiscoverableRegistryRecordsResponse$: The page of discoverable registry record summaries.

FilterValue.base: A single filter value. Constrained by length only; the accepted set of values is filter-specific and validated server-side so enum-style values such as READY or AWS_IAM are accepted.

InternalServerException.base: The request failed due to an unexpected internal error; the caller may retry.

refs.ListDiscoverableRegistryRecordsRequest$m: The maximum number of records to return in a single page. Valid values are 1 through 100.

refs.ListDiscoverableRegistryRecordsRequest$n: The pagination token returned by a previous request. Use this value to retrieve the next page of results.

McpServerAdditionalData.base: Additional data for an MCP server descriptor

McpServerDescriptor.base: Base mixin for MCP server descriptor content

refs.SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecordsRequest: An optional structured JSON metadata filter that narrows the search results. Supports the field-level operators $eq, $ne, and $in, and the logical operators $and and $or on filterable fields.

RecordIdentifier.base: Record identifier that accepts either ARN or ID format

RecordType.base: Record type enum for registry record classification

RegistryIdentifier.base: Registry identifier that accepts either ARN or ID format

RegistryRecordFilter.base: A single filter applied to a ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords request.

RegistryRecordFilterList.base: The list of filters applied to a ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords request.

refs.ListDiscoverableRegistryRecordsRequest$f: The filters to apply to the discoverable registry record list.

RegistryRecordFilterName.base: The attribute to filter registry records on.

RegistryRecordSummary.base: Summary information about a registry record, including its descriptors.

refs.BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecordRespon: The records that were successfully retrieved. Each record correlates to the request by its recordId.
refs.SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecordsRespons: The registry records that match the search query, ordered by relevance.

RegistryRecordsEntry.base: Binds one registry to the record IDs requested from it.

refs.RegistryRecordsEntry$recordIds: The record IDs to retrieve from the registry. You can specify 1 through 100 record IDs.

refs.SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecordsRequest: The maximum number of results to return. Valid values are 1 through 20. The default value is 10.
The registry identifiers to search within. Currently, you must specify exactly one registry identifier. You can provide either the full Amazon Web Services Resource Name (ARN) or the registry ID.
The natural language query to search for matching registry records.

refs.BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecordError$: An optional human-readable detail about the error. Do not parse this value programmatically.
refs.ListDiscoverableRegistryRecordsResponse$: The pagination token to pass to a subsequent request to retrieve the next page of results. This field is absent when there are no more results.
refs.ValidationExceptionField$name: The name of the field that failed validation.
refs.ValidationExceptionField$message: A description of why the field failed validation.

ThrottlingException.base: The request was denied due to request throttling; the caller may retry after a delay.

ValidationException.base: The request failed validation of one or more input fields.

ValidationExceptionField.base: Describes a single input field that failed validation.

refs.ValidationException$fieldList: The list of input fields that failed validation.
